kb.title: Duplicate charge / bill higher than usual
kb.body:
1. Open Billing › Transactions and compare the last two cycles.
2. If a duplicate direct debit is visible, raise refund code RB-2 (auto-approves under £150).
3. Tell the customer the refund lands in 3–5 working days.
4. Wrap: Resolved.

kb.title: Set up a payment arrangement
kb.body:
1. Check arrears balance and eligibility (no plan in last 6 months).
2. Offer 3 or 6 month spread; first payment today locks the plan.
3. Send SMS confirmation with the schedule.
4. Wrap: Payment Taken.

kb.title: Customer threatening to cancel — save offers
kb.body:
1. Acknowledge and ask what's driving the move.
2. Loyalty matrix: 12m+ tenure → 20% for 6 months; 24m+ → free speed upgrade.
3. If declined twice, do NOT push a third time — hand to Retention queue.
4. Wrap: Escalated or Resolved.

kb.title: Router offline / connection drops
kb.body:
1. Run a line test from the account page (takes ~40s — tell the customer).
2. If the line is clean: guided reboot + factory reset.
3. Two failed resets in 7 days → book an engineer, no charge.
4. Wrap: Resolved or Follow-up required.

kb.title: Rebook or chase an engineer visit
kb.body:
1. Apologise for the miss — check the dispatch note first.
2. Offer the next two AM/PM slots; Saturday slots are released Thursdays.
3. Missed-visit credit: one month line rental, code MV-1.
4. Wrap: Follow-up required.

kb.title: Direct debit bounced or failed
kb.body:
1. Never re-run a bounced DD the same day — bank blocks it.
2. Take a card payment now or set a retry date within 10 days.
3. Waive the late fee on first occurrence (code LF-0).
4. Wrap: Payment Taken.
